# Objective-C class prefix inference from the first top-level name: the
# leading capitals but the last one (ABCWidget: AB), at least two of them
# (QT otherwise). A class name shorter than NSString cannot pad the
# --functions prototypes (repeatString fails). With only classes and enums
# no map function is needed.
input schema ABCWidget {"type": "object", "properties": {"x": {"type": "string"}, "k": {"enum": ["a", "b"]}}}
input schema A {"type": "object", "properties": {"y": {"type": "boolean"}}}
pipeline {"lang": "objc"}

render objc {}
render objc {"rendererOptions": {"functions": true}}
render objc {"rendererOptions": {"class-prefix": "ABCD"}}
render objc {"rendererOptions": {"class-prefix": "QT", "functions": true}}
